title: Functional requirements mining for mass personalisation: a heterogeneous data-driven knowledge graph approach to enable product rapid design

context_summary: The paper proposes a heterogeneous data-driven knowledge graph (HDDKG) approach for mining functional requirements (FRs) in mass personalisation. It integrates customer requirements (CRs), technology-driven requirements (TDRs), and FRs into a unified multi-domain representation. The study uses online reviews, patent documents, and product instructions to extract CRs and TDRs, and employs models like QCECM and TDREM for requirement extraction and mapping. The HDDKG is validated through case studies and performance comparisons with baseline methods.
